title: Kenyan-Inspired Grilled Steak with Italian Flair
description: A fusion dish that combines the bold flavors of Kenya with the rich traditions of Italy. Grilled to perfection and served with a side of tangy sauce.

ingredients.name: Grilled Steak
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-quality cut, such as ribeye or sirloin

ingredients.name: Quickly Fermented Kimchi
ingredients.notes: Add a spicy kick to your dish

ingredients.name: Italian Flatbread
ingredients.notes: Perfect for serving as a side

instructions: Season the steak with salt, black pepper, and Kenyan Chai Spice Blend.
Grill the steak for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, grill the Italian flatbread slices for 1-2 minutes per side, or until crispy.
In a small bowl, mix together quickly fermented kimchi, garlic, and Italian parsley.
To serve, place the grilled steak on top of the flatbread slices and spoon the kimchi mixture over the top.
Drizzle with Italian olive oil and sprinkle with red pepper flakes.
Garnish with additional Italian parsley, if desired.
